subject: Leader ends kept clear of other edges' arrowheads (syzygy-pdja.9, owner choice A 2026-11-08)
ranAtNote: Base commit (origin/main); the change ran uncommitted on top of it and is the bytes digested below. The 'main' measurement ran the base commit's diagram-layout.ts with the same scratch harness.
arrowheadModel: marker viewBox 10x10, markerWidth/markerHeight 8 in stroke units, edge stroke 2 at rest: 1.6 px a unit; triangle (0,0),(10,5),(0,10) with ref (9,5), so tip 1.6 px past the end and base 14.4 px back, 16 px wide; oriented along the end tangent from the last control point that differs from the end. A leader end must lie 1.5 px (LEADER_SHARED) or more from every other edge's triangle.

measurement.harness: Scratch vitest file (not committed): four synthetic populations of 1500 graphs, each rendered with READABLE_SPACING. A label is moved if its centre is more than 0.11 px from its natural position. A moved label with no leader is againstOwn if its box is within 6 px of its own curve (2000 samples), else neither. A leader end is endInHead if it lies inside another edge's triangle (the model above, recomputed from the SVG path), endNearHead if within 1.4 px.

populations.T: seed 20261108, 3-10 nodes, label 'carries the request onward'
populations.G: seed 77, 4-9 nodes, 'a long label that wraps twice over'

measurement.reading: Ends inside another edge's arrowhead fall from 71 (27+24+8+12) to 0. Leaders fall by 36 (18+15+3+0); those labels now have neither a leader nor their own line beside them (the fallback the owner accepted). The other 35 rerouted to a clear end. The pre-existing 'neither' population (1,539 of 8,658 moved labels on main) is unchanged in kind.

cost.harness: 40 graphs of 12-20 nodes and 80 edges (the cap), second render timed, two alternating runs each
cost.reading: Within run-to-run noise: medians 85-92 ms both ways.

command: npx vitest run apps/three-surface-poc/src/polaris-generation/ (each mutant applied alone to diagram-layout.ts, restored after)
firstRunNote: A first run of the same 8 mutants against the population test alone killed 3 (no-head-filter, unit-1.0, short-head); the geometry unit tests and the own-arrowhead count were added to kill the other 5.
